annotation.title_clean: Caribbean AI Taskforce Final Report on AI Harmonization
annotation.title_en: Caribbean AI Taskforce Final Report on AI Harmonization
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Caribbean AI Taskforce (Chair: Dr Craig Ramlal), supported by CARICOM Secretariat and ITU
named_instruments_referenced: UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of AI
Council of Europe Framework Convention on AI
annotation.summary_en: Final report of the Caribbean AI Taskforce recommending harmonized AI policy across CARICOM. It documents the region's AI investment gap, labour exposure and the absence of a collective AI instrument, and proposes seven pillars covering data infrastructure, a UNESCO-anchored governance framework, economic transformation, resilience and global representation.
key_provisions_or_claims: CARICOM is the only comparable bloc with no collective AI instrument.
Develop a regional AI governance framework anchored in the UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of AI.
Set minimum regional standards for algorithmic transparency, risk classification and public-sector AI procurement.
Strengthen an existing regional body for oversight rather than necessarily creating a new one.
Harmonize data protection and cross-border data flows, and assess AI for disparate impact across Caribbean languages and groups.
